title: Complete UI-at-scale palette and corrected delivery coverage
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: complete scaling UI palette; later internal corrections/delivery scope and current owners qualified
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full1851-line review retains SC1–SC5, NV1–NV6, IN1–IN7, MW1–MW4, EN1–EN6, PC1–PC6, PL1–PL4, ZN1–ZN4, CS1–CS8, local MC1–MC9, UGR1–UGR22, U1-GR, MO1–MO12, TP1–TP4, DP1–DP4, GP1–GP4, NP1–NP5, WT1–WT4, SO1–SO2, VI1–VI5, FR1–FR4, SF1–SF3, AN1–AN4, MK1–MK3, SB1–SB3, LP1–LP4, PT1–PT3, SH1–SH2, QL1–QL2, MI1–MI72, AX1–AX12, IG1–IG7, MA1–MA7, OI1–OI32, U1–U13 returns, CB/MP/DV/MX/LS/CF/RT/TY/TT families, SX1–SX6, GU1–GU10, OT1–OT7 and ID1–ID7. Counts describe this palette's structure, not implemented surfaces. Local MC, RT and SB codes differ from identically prefixed engine codes; use the document or U-lane qualifier. UGR replaces the reserved GR prefix, while U1-GR retains the distinct lane mapping.

F2: Later corrections govern the early proposal shorthand. SC3 visibility/relevance is not a sufficient discovery or secrecy filter. Known index, active eligibility, muted/dormant state and actual actor knowledge differ; undiscovered names stay hidden in search, labels, tooltips, clipboard, speech and exports. U1's watch overview is separate from the urgent queue. U5 refines one contextual slot to one foreground transaction with dependent decisions, draft/back-stack and Compare/pop-out where useful. U6 refines known-category percent to discovered count until an actual catalogue denominator is learned; freshness/provenance remains attached to data. Perceived, reachable and controlled are distinct map facts, and remote incompatible clocks/currencies/XP cannot be silently totaled. Stock, rate, reservation, committed capacity, digest, causal record and calculation are different questions.

F3: The UGR and OI tables began as MEMORY. Their later sourced lane corrections supersede them without turning every external example into a verified local UI. Dark cockpit is quiet normal annunciation, not a ban on role/world/selection/success color. An overview is an entry route, not a toll before a direct link. i3/Emacs inspired stable state/focus mechanisms, not a compulsory no-floating layout or imported keymap. A sheet may use Play/Build/Records/Reference rather than one forced page. Event-driven clocks show obstacle and advancement, not a false time estimate or author-only future. Revealed, read, dismissed, taught and performed are separate facts. Read/acknowledge/shelve/suppress/resolve need their own lifecycles. Source/row totals, twelve ASCII views and illustrative672/680 height arithmetic do not prove browser fit, comprehension or a universal20-system/30-card threshold.

F4: Current UI_RULES owns1920×1080, MacBook and1536×864 targets and actual14/21px checks;1366×768 was explicitly retired and neither old floor nor683px half-width proposal creates a new gate. MA4's one-realm/prestige now phase is historical after October24 direction. Thematic palette placement ideas do not replace DESIGN as the current look owner. Fixed-home/skin/icon prescriptions, passive enemy readings, one attention channel, all-transcript retention, universal undo/confirm and infinite-value UI are defaults/proposals, not world laws. A disclosed extraordinary observer or UI-affecting mechanism can have its own real reach; broad display mask or screenshot-safe mode does not alter NPC knowledge. Symbolic limitless magnitudes need a declared display/domain representation, not NaN/Infinity in conserved save quantities.

F5: Preserve truthful interaction boundaries under UR35/UR41/UR43/UR58. MI28 optimistic feedback may show pending intent, never a settled paid result before the real commit. A minimum completion flash cannot extend gameplay time. MI18 debounce handles an accidental repeated gesture; two legitimate deliberate paid commands remain distinct intents. Hover, focus, inspect, pin, compare and act differ; do not make a preview or Escape cancel work or silently discard a draft. Keyboard Details and persistent inspectors replace link-bearing ephemeral tooltips. Sorting/selection/scroll/typed drafts remain stable when data refreshes. Status color, mood sigils, precise rates, comparative ghosts and missing-piece explanations use known evidence, with neutral unknown where appropriate. A collapsed header or missing-pack placeholder cannot name undiscovered content. Layout/pin/filter state has its own reset scope and cannot change the run or fabricate knowledge.

F6: Later Round12 supersedes Round11's blanket nothing-built/selection questions. It records the command palette, shortcut registry, native-path loadouts, known things, statistics, today/region/companion views, row menu, badges, contrast, text presets and divider reset on its exact October20 build. Existing compare, shortcut sheet, Journal tabs and many empty states were not absent; GU3 therefore required no new build, and GU4 per1366 viewport store was retired. The palette's Here entries actually click an existing action, so navigation-only shorthand does not make every palette item read-only. That explicit action still uses its actual native guard. Loadouts store item keys and report changed/missing keys rather than guessing ownership; they are not per-copy title transfer or arbitrary equipment bypass. SX4 added no new preference slice; GU6/GU10 reuse existing stores. Badges are page-load baseline state, not persisted unseen-history truth.

F7: Round12's2285-test total, no-growth architecture and rebuilt1920 route are historical proof. It demonstrated stored loadouts, reload and literal real-file Import with valid/damaged slice; Export was not separately driven, so no complete Export journey can be inferred from same-envelope reasoning. Synthetic keydown is not a real Ctrl/Cmd+K chord. Actual pointer hover, real region travel, overflow badges, per-activity/per-world counters and changed-key loadouts retain their named gaps. The early discovered=eligible implementation and once-known retention require current scrutiny if that consumer is selected; they are not a generally correct secrecy model. Human review is optional under AD42 and current UR2 permits already authorized homes without another review ceremony; proposal feature promotion remains governed by real director direction. No present browser or installed state was reverified here.

F8: Round13's ID1–ID7 adjacent/source-anchored details, wider comparison and optional setting remain a proposal based on one screenshot, not an applied left-dock layout or current defect. Current UR43 now defines optional hover plus stable pinned/keyboard inspection rather than the old pending-selection label. A task may compare the real source row/side/covered facts without forcing every inspection left or covering needed body facts. ER11's component/source probes and frozen1366 measurements remain their own evidence: paired handler calls do not by themselves prove an end-to-end duplicate paid purchase, HTML sink risk is not a demonstrated exploit and312 layouts is not latency/causal attribution. Isolate a broken renderer while preserving authoritative failure handling. Panel gallery, contribution registry, generated IA, policy editor, analytics, battery mode, complete world skins and all72 micro cues are retained useful candidates, not delivered by the named Round12 subset. All old worker-running notes, delegation/commit recipes and proposed tooling gates are historical. No UI, save, clock, source corpus or gameplay change is made by this full-owner review.
reviews.evidence: Entire1851-line actual owner read in spans1–140,141–280,281–420,421–560,561–700,701–840,841–980,981–1120,1121–1260,1261–1400,1401–1540,1541–1680,1681–1790,1791–1851. Supporting exact current UI_RULES matches for UR2/3/14/25/35/41/43/46/58/70 inspected. No underlying lane source, browser screenshot, runtime or historical check replay.
reviews.reopen: Select one actual UI consumer and current owner, use current desktop/knowledge/action rules, and preserve each unproved export, input, travel or layout claim rather than reactivating old full-palette proposals.
